svg.title: High-genus slices of one translator end in four-space
svg.desc: Three separate horizontal slices, shown at a common spatial scale, of a schematic auxiliary end. Their heights have ratio 1 to 4 to 9, so their sizes have ratio 1 to 2 to 3. Each is one connected doubled sphere with twenty necks on two aligned latitude circles, of model genus nineteen. The third slice is cut away to reveal the gold inner sheet and copper necks joining it to the blue outer sheet. These are two-dimensional slices in three-space of a three-dimensional end in four-space, not three ends or a three-dimensional projection of the entire translator. The shrinker is schematic and the unknown normal correction and compact core are omitted.

g.text: One end in ℝ⁴, seen through its horizontal slices
Each slice is a connected surface in ℝ³. The fourth coordinate is the height z.
Increasing height z · separate slices at a common spatial scale, not a 3D embedding
SCHEMATIC: enlarged necks; uₘ omitted; no computed shrinker, translator, or compact core.
z* denotes a large reference height. m = 10 is illustrative; existence requires sufficiently large m.
